text: Stop: no behaviour to explain. On 500 fresh inputs (seed 1) the model agrees with the dataset answers 34.6% of the time (chance 1/3), mean logit diff 0.016 clean vs -0.018 corrupt (E0003); seed 0 gave 40.5% on 200 (E0002). The labels this dataset supplies are not related to what the model outputs, so any circuit 'found' against this metric would be a false discovery. No mechanism search, no verify_hypothesis run. 22 of 25 experiments unused.
